annotations.title: Approve, reject or give feedback on a campaign post

description: Use this when the user approves, rejects or gives feedback on a creator's submitted post. Approve a submitted post (it earns under the campaign's payout model; earnings are held, then payable), reject it with a reason (anything it earned and was not yet paid is cancelled), request_changes (say what to change; atSecond points at a moment in the video; the creator replies when it is done and it comes back for review), or comment. Everything lands in the post's feedback thread on the creator's page, and the creator is emailed (several updates within a few minutes go as one email). Hermoso never rejects on its own.

comment.description: what to change, or the comment

reason.description: required to reject; the creator sees it

views.description: set_views: on a platform Hermoso cannot read, the approved count
